Enemies prioritize attacking targets with the Taunt effect. Concentrated Fire targets are prioritized over Taunt. If multiple targets are taunted, the earliest in the action order is prioritized.
Energy Guard is consumed before HP when taking damage.\nIf multiple Energy Guards are stacked, they deplete in the order they were activated.\nPure DMG ignores Energy Guard, dealing direct damage.

Enemies concentrate attacks on targets with the Concentrated Fire effect.\nConcentrated Fire targets are prioritized over Taunt. If multiple targets are in a Concentrated Fire state, the earliest in the action order is prioritized.
Silenced targets can't reserve skills, and any reserved skills are canceled with SP refunded.
Auras provide certain effects to nearby allies.\nThese effects disappear if the unit with the Aura dies and cannot be removed by removal effects.
Transforms the target's appearance and grants additional effects.\nWhile transformed, SP cost and cooldown for the skill are reduced to 0.\nTransformations can't be removed by removal effects.
This is a skill that can be activated preemptively before the battle begins.

While the Target Avoidance effect is active, the character doesn't become the main target of enemies, unless no other targets are available.\nTaunt and Concentrated Fire take priority over Target Avoidance.

When attacking with a property advantage, your damage increases by the property damage value.\n\nFor instance, with a 50% property damage increase, dealing 100 damage to a weaker property results in 150 damage.
The main target is the single square at the center of the skill's range.
The sub targets are all targets except the single central square within the skill's range.
While Wrath effect is active, gain an additional effect upon being hit.\nThe applied effect does not stack.
Barrier reduces damage received.\n\nFor instance, with a 50% Barrier and 50% DEF, taking 100 damage is reduced to 25 due to the Barrier and DEF.
Vulnerability increases damage received.\n\nFor instance, with a 25% Vulnerability, taking 100 damage results in 125 damage due to the effects of Vulnerability.
Successfully evading ignores all effects and damage, but self-destruct and counters cannot be evaded.
If you survive after being hit, you counter the enemy, dealing damage or applying effects.\nCounters apply for each attack received.
Summons units sequentially starting from the forward left of your formation.
Summons units sequentially starting from the top-left of the skill's range, moving to the right.

Physical Vulnerability increases Incoming Physical Type DMG the target receives. For instance, with a 25% Physical Vulnerability, taking 100 damage results in 125 damage due to the effects of Vulnerability.
Magic Vulnerability increases Incoming Magic Type DMG the target receives. For instance, with a 25% Magic Vulnerability, taking 100 damage results in 125 damage due to the effects of Vulnerability.

SP is the points needed to use skills in battle. A set amount is provided at the start of battle, and you may earn additional SP at the end of each turn, depending on the in-game content. Additional SP can also be gained through basic and knockback attacks or by using SP restoring skills.
Bleed inflicts DoT damage at the end of each turn.
Burn inflicts DoT damage at the end of each turn.
Poison inflicts DoT damage at the end of each turn.
Rot inflicts DoT damage at the end of each turn.
Shock inflicts DoT damage at the end of each turn.
Frostbite inflicts DoT damage at the end of each turn.
When stacking Chains through attacks, extra Chains are added based on the Chain Reinforcement value. This effect occurs with each attack.
When Chains stack from taking hits, extra Chains are added based on the Chain Weakening value. This effect occurs with each attack.
Under the Pressure effect, the efficiency of stat-boosting effects is reduced. For instance, with a 20% Pressure effect, a 200% ATK increase effect becomes 160%.
This is the basic attack characters use, excluding skill and knockback attacks.
Stack Application skills become more effective with the number of stacks.\n\nFor instance, if each stack provides 10% increase in ATK, then with 3 stacks, ATK increases by 30%.
Augmentation increases damage dealt.\n\nFor instance, with a 25% Augmentation effect, dealing 100 damage results in 125 damage.

Each attack adds a Chain stack to the target, with each stack increasing the next attack's damage by 10%. For example, if a target has 3 stacks and receives 100 damage, the Chain effect increases it to 130 damage.

 - Multi-hit attacks add a stack for each hit.
 - Counters and DoTs do not add Chain stacks.
 - Stacks reset at the end of the turn.
This type uses the ATK stat instead of Magic ATK for its attacks.
This type uses the Magic ATK stat instead of ATK for its attacks.
In the Overdrive state, the boss's skills are enhanced. If certain conditions are met, it can also use Overdrive skills.
